args:
P="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; NL='
'
[ -n "$P" ] || exit 0
# 564: keep the literal sentinel form; drift and hook-unwire read it from this text
[ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/scan-forge-writes" ] && exec python3 "$0"
# 558: the default branch's tree counts too; the rule is forge-lib's _forge_default_ref
t=$(git -C "$P" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$t" ] || exit 0
[ "$(cd -P "$t" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)" = "$(cd -P "$P" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)" ] || exit 0
r="${FORGE_REMOTE:-}"
if [ -z "$r" ]; then
  r=origin; n=$(git -C "$P" remote 2>/dev/null) || n=""
  case "$n" in ''|*"$NL"*) ;; *) r="$n" ;; esac
fi
case "$r" in *[!ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789._-]*) exit 0 ;; esac
f=$(git -C "$P" for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' "refs/remotes/$r/" 2>/dev/null)
for w in HEAD main master; do
  case "$NL$f$NL" in *"${NL}refs/remotes/$r/$w$NL"*)
    o=$(GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 git -C "$P" ls-tree --full-tree --name-only "refs/remotes/$r/$w" .claude/scan-forge-writes 2>/dev/null) || exec python3 "$0"
    [ -n "$o" ] && exec python3 "$0"
    exit 0 ;;
  esac
done
exit 0
